_comment: Vanilla TreeFeatures/TreePlacements and the tree parts of VegetationFeatures/VegetationPlacements (1.21.5+: leaf litter, fallen trees). '*_checked' and other plain tree names carry the sapling-survival filter vanilla's TreePlacements add; trees_*, birch_tall, bamboo_vegetation, dark_forest_vegetation, mushroom_island_vegetation and rooted_azalea_tree are what biomes run.
